elements.text: Example: Estimate Twitter QPS and storage requirements
elements.rawText: Example: Estimate Twitter QPS and storage requirements
elements.originalText: Example: Estimate Twitter QPS and storage requirements

elements.text:
Assumptions:
- 300 million active users
- 50% of users use Twitter daily
- Users post 2 tweets per day on average
- 10% of tweets contain media
- Data is stored for 5 years

elements.text:
Estimations
- Daily Active users (DAU) = 300 millions * 50% = 150 millions
- Tweets QPS = 150 million * 2 tweets / 10^6 = 3500 qps
- Peek QPS = 2 * QPS = 7000 ( approx )
